name: TaserDerby
shortDescription: Party betting game: pick a racer in a physics sim; if it loses, the web app tells an ESP32-C3 to fire a handmade taser via a relay.
description:
TaserDerby is a race-betting game with real stakes. Bet on a racer in a physics-based "microscopic" race drawn on an HTML canvas; if your racer finishes outside the target rank, the React app sends a POST to an ESP32-C3, which triggers a relay on a handmade taser for a short shock.

Highlights:
- Real-time physics-based race on HTML Canvas, with a difficulty slider for the required finishing rank (top 1 to top 8).
- ESP32-C3 running an async web server; a relay module on its own 5 V supply isolates the shock circuit.
- 3D-printed enclosure (CAD in the repo) and a wiring diagram.
- Fullscreen modal UI for betting and results, styled as a microscope view.

Built at GoOnHacks (November 2025).
